summary: Backend testing complete for Excel Inventory API. All 16 pytest tests passed (100%). Verified upload-excel processes 19780 rows; recap contains TOTAL EEG=76366, 4 spare lines (EEG=3819, Fixation=2091, Rail=610, Caméra=175), 1 inclineur Rail=9669, 3 empty trailing lines; 154 secteur rows with all required fields; dataset retrieval; Excel export produces 3 sheets (Données, Récapitulatif, Par Secteur); error handling returns 400 for non-Excel files and Excel files with missing columns; 404 for unknown upload_id.

minor.issue: Mongo insert uses `logger` which is defined below the function; if the Mongo insert raises, a NameError on `logger` would surface before logging. Currently in-flight because logger module exists at runtime, but ordering is fragile.
Per-row .apply(classify_eeg) is O(n) Python loop; with 19780 rows acceptable but worth vectorizing for larger files.
In-memory dict not bounded; multiple uploads will grow memory. Acceptable for MVP but should add LRU/expiry later.

critical_code_review_comments: logger is initialized AFTER the endpoint functions that reference it (line 443 vs use at line 308). Move logging.basicConfig + logger = ... above @api_router definitions to avoid future NameError risk.
DATASTORE is unbounded in-memory; consider TTL or LRU eviction for production.
is_inclineur_rail uses regex per row via .apply; fine for 19780 rows (<1s) but could be vectorized via str.contains for large files.
Hardcoded CORS '*' default — acceptable for MVP, document for prod.
seed_data_creation: Used existing /tmp/sample.xlsx (19780 rows). Tests also generate a tiny in-memory invalid xlsx for the missing-columns error case.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sample file /tmp/sample.xlsx is the canonical test fixture. All backend assertions on totals (EEG=76366, spares 3819/2091/610/175, inclineur=9669, secteur rows=154) pass. Backend ready; frontend testing not yet performed.
